name: WebP Tools
author: Oracast Inc

sections.description:
JPG/PNG to WebP Converter helps improve your website’s performance by automatically converting uploaded JPG and PNG images into the WebP format. WebP images are smaller and faster-loading, making your site more efficient and SEO-friendly.

Features

  • Automatically convert new JPG and PNG uploads to WebP
  • Bulk convert existing media library images
  • Seamless integration with WordPress Media Library

Why Use WebP?

WebP is a modern image format developed by Google, offering superior compression and quality characteristics compared to traditional image formats. This results in faster page loads and reduced bandwidth usage.

Credits

Developed by Oracast

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings from Settings > WebP Converter.
